query: create or replace function public.portfolio_is_member() returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$ select exists (select 1 from public.portfolio_members m where lower(m.email) = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))); $$; create or replace function public.portfolio_can_edit() returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$ select exists (select 1 from public.portfolio_members m where lower(m.email) = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', '')) and m.role in ('admin','editor'));
